releaseNotes:
LifeOS v4.1.0 (4.1.0 · Build 94):
• Unified Floating Capsule Header: Added centered interface CapsuleHeader with quick Back/Directory and Sync/Reload controls seamlessly matched across Home, primary, and sub-interfaces.
• Nutrition Engine Upgrade: Warm Brown 5-arc calorie ring with crisp text contrast, Skip lock whenever a meal item is logged, AI-computed per-item protein (g P) across mess & outside meals, and lazy-loaded mess menu.
• Accurate Hardware & System-Managed Performance Tiers: Native Android DeviceHardware plugin reporting real device model, RAM, CPU cores, GPU, and storage with read-only Auto-Selected T1/T2/T3 tiers.
• Zero-Lag 120Hz Mobile Smoothness: Removed layout animations, transition-all, and blurs; added routePrefetch pre-warming and 2-phase hydration with 0px mobile overflow across all 22 routes.
